caption: The drawing features a central composition dominated by a large, light brown bull with yellow and pink decorative lines, standing amidst stylized green foliage and plants. To the left, there is a brown-trunked tree with dark green and yellow leaves, and further greenery spreads across the foreground. Two human figures, depicted in light tan with simple outlines, appear to the right of the bull: one standing and aiming a bow with an arrow, and the other running. In the sky above the bull are two flying human figures, colored similarly, with one holding a curved object and the other appearing to hold a stick. The background contains stylized green hills with dark brown and yellow accents, representing the landscape. The entire scene is set against a muted green background, bordered on the left and right by thick vertical maroon lines. At the top of the image, there is a horizontal ornamental band with a repeating spiral pattern in pink, black, teal, and blue on a light blue field, bordered with pink lines. The drawing uses a palette of predominantly green, brown, pink, yellow, and tan colors.
title: Bandbox Design - Rhino
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
